Pop the hood on continuous diffusion language models and the picture shifts from magic parallel

The core move is to keep representations continuous through the entire denoising trajectory,
instead of snapping to tokens at each step.
That choice removes the need for an intermediate vocabulary, but demands a strong teacher signal to keep the trajectory on track.
Adding the frozen autoregressive supervisor lifts pass rates on GSM 8000 and Human Eval at modest network function evaluation budgets.
